correctness.rationale: For each \(n=2,3,4,5\), codewords are compatible exactly when their one-deletion balls and two-consecutive-deletion balls are separately disjoint, so the optimum is the clique number of the explicitly constructed compatibility graph. The submitted branch-and-bound uses a proper greedy coloring only as an upper bound and branches exhaustively. A fresh independently written exact clique computation reconstructed every ternary word and both deletion balls and reproduced the optima \(1,3,7,13\). The displayed codes attain those sizes.
